title: On Wrestling with the eldest boy at the fair
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：wrestle　|　正文 359 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wrestle 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the cook ① wrestled with the eldest boy at the fair in silence, and every guest in the canteen said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the cook ② wrestles with the eldest boy at the fair twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ wrestle with the eldest boy at the fair at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ wrestled with the eldest boy at the fair before — a line in the menu for September 1966 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Wrestling with the eldest boy at the fair in silence, the cook said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ wrestle with the accounts all night twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Wrestle with the accounts all night at once and never mention it again.

By 1979 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the menu, and a new guest from the next canteen ⑧ wrestles with the accounts all night in silence every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the table, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ wrestled with the eldest boy at the fair again when nobody else would.

⑩ To wrestle with the eldest boy at the fair, my mother said in 1984, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the canteen remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the canteen forgets, somebody wrestles with the eldest boy at the fair twice over again and somebody must wrestle with the eldest boy at the fair in silence all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。

B. v. 摔跤（一般现在 wrestles with the eldest boy at the fair：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 摔跤（不定式 to wrestle with the eldest boy at the fair：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 摔跤（过去完成时 had wrestled with the eldest boy at the fair：1966 年九月的菜单上那行字之前就有人做过）

G. v. 奋力 （wrestle with the accounts all night：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 摔跤（后段两处：新来的客人照例 wrestles with the accounts all night，而母亲又一次 wrestled with the eldest boy at the fair）

wrestle 意为“摔跤”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地摔跤在集市上与最大的男孩角力，用一般过去式 wrestled 叙述。
wrestle 意为“摔跤”，结尾那句是母亲 1984 年的话：要摔跤在集市上与最大的男孩角力，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和食堂记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 wrestle 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1972 the cook wrestled with the eldest boy at the fair in silence, and nobody in the canteen forgot it.
Even now the cook wrestles with the eldest boy at the fair twice over whenever the canteen asks.
Wrestling with the eldest boy at the fair in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever wrestle with the accounts all night twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new guest from the next canteen wrestles with the accounts all night in silence every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother wrestled with the eldest boy at the fair again, and the canteen remembered that half.
